name: Liquid-level actuation qualifier
summary: This qualifier identifies actuation responding to liquid level.
description: This qualifier identifies actuation responding to liquid level. Level is the process condition that initiates operation. It should be distinguished from a drawing of the level instrument, the electrical output contact and the control action that follows.

In a generator fuel system, for example, a level input may participate in pump control or an alarm. The qualifier identifies the input principle while the cause-and-effect schedule states what happens.
readingNotes: State the sensed vessel or level point and the associated contact condition.
A level-actuation qualifier does not provide a setpoint or switch mounting height.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.
State the sensed vessel or level point and the associated contact condition.
Cross-reference the equipment data, terminal mapping or operating-state legend needed to interpret the form.
